title: Band Flat 402 Ka Meter Raat Mein Kyu Dauda?
hooks: Chhe saal se band flat ka bijli meter achanak tez daudne laga!
Sharma ji ne ghabra kar chai gira di jab flat 402 ka naam suna.
Basement ke bijli meter box mein Mehul ka number kisne chipkaya?
hook_why: Starts directly at frame 0 with an impossible real-world mystery and high curiosity: a locked sealed flat burning heavy electricity.
metaphor: A locked apartment's spinning electricity meter as undeniable physical proof that someone is secretly inside.

cast.Mehul: 27 years old Indian man, lean frame, messy black hair, wearing a faded navy t-shirt, holding a smartphone with cracked screen protector.
cast.Raghav: 27 years old Indian man, Mehul's observant friend, mustard hoodie, short curly hair, carrying an aluminium torch.
cast.Sharma ji: 58 years old Mumbai society watchman, thick graying mustache, khaki uniform with faded brass buttons, nervous eyes, holding a wooden lathi.

scenes.vo: Chhe saal se band flat ka bijli meter achanak tez daudne laga!
scenes.prompt: Cinematic night thriller footage, film grain, cold teal shadows, amber light. Macro view of an old Indian analogue electricity meter dial spinning rapidly, red pulse light blinking vigorously on weathered basement board, realistic textures, no fake text overlays.
scenes.title: SPEED RUN

scenes.vo: Mehul ne security guard Sharma ji se poocha, toh unke haath kaanpne lage.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic night thriller still. 58 years old Mumbai society watchman, thick graying mustache, khaki uniform with faded brass buttons, spilling a steaming cutting chai glass in panic, rain-slicked pavement outside security booth.

scenes.vo: Sharma ji bole, 2018 se flat band hai aur chabi kisi ke paas nahi.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic still. Aged wooden apartment door number 402 in a dim apartment hallway, locked with a heavy rusted padlock and iron chain, peeling paint, cobwebs, atmospheric dim corridor light.
scenes.title: SEALED 402

scenes.vo: Dost Raghav bola, sach janna hai toh pehle basement ka meter room dekh.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 still. A single young Indian man in a dark hoodie standing alone in a dimly lit stairwell, holding a flashlight with a tense and serious expression. One clear subject centered, ample negative space at top and bottom for text, dramatic shadowy lighting, no other people, no text, no logos.

scenes.vo: Dono chupchap seedhiyan utar kar andhere basement panel tak pahunche.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic low-angle still. Two young Indian men descending narrow wet concrete stairs into a pitch-black society basement, torch beam slicing through damp airborne dust particles.

scenes.vo: Wahan line se lage baaki saare meters bilkul thande pade the.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic wide still. A row of dusty grey electrical meter boxes on a peeling basement wall, red indicator lights idle and stationary, thick bundles of black insulated conduit wires.
scenes.title: IDLE METERS

scenes.vo: Lekin flat 402 ka meter disc poori speed mein ghoom raha tha!
scenes.prompt: Cinematic extreme close-up clip. Electrical meter labelled 402 vibrating subtly under heavy load, aluminium disc whirling frantically behind scratched glass, flashing bright warning LED.

scenes.vo: Matlab band darwaze ke peeche koi bhari machine ya appliance chal raha tha.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 still. A heavy locked metal basement door chained shut, with thick industrial power cables running underneath it and a faint eerie glow from the door gap. Centered subject, atmospheric dark basement corridor, ample negative space at top and bottom for text overlay, no text, no logos.
scenes.title: HEAVY LOAD

scenes.vo: Mehul ne aage badhkar meter box ka zang laga dhakkan khola.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic shot. Close-up of young Indian hands prying open a creaking rusted sheet-metal electrical hatch, phone flashlight casting hard shadows across exposed fuses and old dust.

scenes.vo: Dhakkan ke theek peeche ek bilkul taaza safed parchi chipki hui thi.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic high-detail macro still. Inside of rusted metal panel door, a clean folded white slip of paper secured with clear cellophane tape against oxidized red iron.
scenes.title: NOTE FOUND

scenes.vo: Laal ink se us par likha tha Mehul aur uska personal phone number!
scenes.prompt: Cinematic macro shot. Smartphone torch beam illuminating red ink handwritten Indian script and modern ten digit mobile phone numbers on a crisp note, high tension atmosphere.

scenes.vo: Tabhi basement ka akela bulb jhatke se bujh gaya.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 suspense shot of a completely unlit, dark glass bulb hanging dead from a ceiling wire in a pitch-black basement. A tiny faint wisp of smoke rises from the cold switched-off filament, room plunged into sudden darkness, centered subject, ample negative space at top and bottom, photorealistic, no text.
scenes.title: BLACKOUT

scenes.vo: Part 3 mein dekhiye Mehul ka darr aur wo raaz. Follow karo.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic dramatic still. Mehul staring into pitch-black hallway with phone flashlight raised, eyes wide with apprehension, cold teal and eerie amber backlight.

caption:
Flat 402 che saal se band hai... toh basement mein meter poori speed mein kaun dauda raha hai? ⚡ Aur meter box ke andar Mehul ka personal number kisne chipkaya?

Part 3 kal raat theek isi waqt.

Aapke hisaab se band kamre mein kaun chupa hai?

claims.claim: Residential electricity meter discs rotate and digital indicators pulse faster when heavy appliances draw high electrical load.
claims.basis: Standard electromechanical and digital kilowatt-hour meter operating principles.
